city: Use case: style-transfer / background-extraction. Create one clean BACKGROUND PLATE for an OCLR tournament homepage banner, landscape 2:1, 2048x1024 or larger. Input image is the existing scene and is the geometry/layout reference. Remove the girl entirely, remove all close foreground stairs/wall, branches and flying petals; reconstruct the distant city behind them. Preserve the precise existing spatial composition: mountain skyline near mid-height, distinctive slender tower around 54% from left, sunset disk just to its right, river with long low bridges cutting across the lower third, vertical rectangular city buildings and their perspective. DO NOT redesign the city or move its major architectural geometry. Restyle the remaining city/river/mountains/sky into a more realistic cinematic architectural matte painting with believable stone, glass, atmospheric depth and restrained warm window lights. Lavender-indigo twilight and soft peach sunset, realistic subtle clouds instead of busy anime confetti. Fine detail, quiet enough to show a thin outline logo over the LEFT half. No characters, no typography, no logos, no opaque left gradient (we add that in CSS). Only city/river/mountains/sky; extend city/river down to the bottom where foreground was removed. This is an art-direction draft based on the original composition.
liru: Use case: identity-preserve / background-extraction. Generate a single isolated full-body character cutout, genuine transparent alpha background, no environment, no ground, no wall or seat, no lettering outside tiny outfit badge. This will be the independently movable right-hand foreground subject of a tournament banner. Image 1 is the authoritative Liru character design sheet: preserve lavender short hair with ponytail on HER right (viewer left), purple eyes, tiny green sprout ahoge, pale lavender hit-circle halo, red-and-blue crossed hair clips, lavender athletic jacket with deep-purple ribbed cuffs, white T-shirt, gray pleated skirt, green six-bead bracelet on her right wrist, T4 badge, white socks and white sneakers with HER right shoe red accents and HER left shoe blue accents. Young adult university freshman, modest athletic outfit. Image 2 supplies ONLY the pose and expression: seated in three-quarter view with relaxed legs together angled slightly left, one elbow resting on her knee and cheek supported by that hand, the other palm resting on an invisible ledge on her other side, looking warmly toward camera with a small slightly playful smile. Do NOT use the Chinese tunic or black shoes from image 2. Preserve the reference-sheet identity. Render as refined semi-realistic anime game key art, fine clean lines with believable fabric folds and soft lavender-peach sunset rim light from behind-left; cooler gentle fill from front. Keep the entire head, sprout, halo, fingers and BOTH SHOES inside frame with small margins. No cut-off feet. Portrait 1024x1536. Fully transparent everywhere around the figure including between arms/legs and hair strands; no fake checkerboard, no white background, no cast shadow rectangle. No extra props or people.
foreground: Use case: background-extraction / style-transfer. Create a transparent foreground architectural plate for compositing over a separate city background, landscape 2:1. Input is original geometry reference. Retain ONLY the lowest foreground stone terrace, stone wall and three broad stone steps with sparse trailing purple plants. Preserve the diagonal perspective of the original ledges: terrace/stair edges run from low left to higher right; broad seating ledge on the RIGHT at about 67% image height, lower steps below it. There must be a clean broad stone seat around x=77%, y=68% for a separately rendered seated character. Extend the stone base to the bottom image edge. Match the original camera and architectural edge positions as closely as possible. No girl, no people, no skyline, no buildings, no river, no mountain, no sky. The entire upper 60% and all space above the terrace edges must be truly transparent alpha, not black or white painted background. Materials more realistic cinematic lavender-grey stone with believable cracks, subtle peach rim light from upper-center sunset, deep purple shaded faces, subdued purple-green plants sparsely at lower corners. No floating petals, no text, no logos. All surrounding empty space is transparent. Render at least 1792x896.
